thesis: Agents that operate real phones should be measured on real phones, by the phone. Blolabel runs 80 public tasks on a physical iPhone and grades them from device state, not from a model's own account of what it did. The headline result: a screenshot is worth 100 points or zero, never in between. When the answer is in the accessibility tree the image changes nothing; when it exists only as pixels, the image is the entire task.
audience: researchers building GUI and computer-use agents
engineers choosing between accessibility-tree and vision-based mobile automation
people who evaluate agents and distrust self-reported success
teams costing out vision tokens against measurable gain

clusters.name: Real devices vs simulators and mocks
targetQuestions: why do mobile agent benchmarks disagree with real device behaviour?
how do you grade an agent task without trusting the agent's own report?
is a simulator good enough for evaluating phone agents?

clusters.name: Vision versus the accessibility tree
targetQuestions: do GUI agents need screenshots or is the accessibility tree enough?
what does a screenshot actually cost per step and when is it worth it?
when does vision change the outcome for a phone agent?

clusters.name: How to evaluate an agent honestly
targetQuestions: how many runs do you need to claim an agent is better?
what is the difference between a failed task and a task that was never scored?

clusters.name: Where phone agents actually break
targetQuestions: what makes phone agents fail on real hardware?
how many steps does a typical phone task take an agent?
which iPhone tasks are hardest for AI agents?

houseFacts: 80 public tasks, run on a physical iPhone 17 Pro Max on iOS 26.6
120 paired runs across 3 frontier models, pre-registered
100% success with the screenshot and 0% without it when the answer is pixels-only; p < 0.0001
the screenshot adds about 35% to per-step cost
tasks are graded from device state, not from the model's own report
tasks never attempted (rate limit, app missing) are reported as not scored, never as failures
